facts.fact: The DRC digital economy minister's office says a decree creating an electronic certification authority exists and sets the direction for managing the .cd domain, with no service stated in operation.

COD.note: The national data centre is a project seeking financing; none stated in service.
A stated aim of local hosting, with no rule on keeping data in the country.

facts.fact: The DRC digital economy minister's office says the government is seeking financing from DBSA, Ghana International Bank and D'Arrigo International for a national data centre to host data locally and strengthen state control over its digital assets, plus a national CDN, on 17 November 2026.

COD.note: Document states nothing on an e-commerce or electronic transactions law.
Planned, seeking financing; none in service.
